Container.Name: OpenCode-Plus
Container.Overview: OpenCode Plus packages OpenCode Server with a durable Ubuntu-based development environment, persistent workspace state, SSH access, an optional Cloudflare Access aware gateway, and OpenCode Plus UI/status enhancements.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent OpenCode Plus configuration, logs, gateway state, and restored root state.

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: Default OpenCode workspace directory. Use a share or appdata path that should hold project/session documentation and non-repo workspace files.

Config.Name: Repositories
Config.Description: Optional directory for local Git clones used inside OpenCode Plus.

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Optional host Docker socket for Docker-aware agents, Docker CLI, Compose, and devcontainer workflows. Remove this mapping if you do not want the container to control Docker.

Config.Name: Gateway Web UI Port
Config.Description: OpenCode Plus gateway and injected UI. Use this port for the WebUI when OPENCODE_CF_AUTH_ENABLED is true.

Config.Name: Direct OpenCode Port
Config.Description: Direct OpenCode server port. Use only on trusted networks or when the Cloudflare Access gateway is disabled.

Config.Name: SSH Port
Config.Description: SSH access for remote editors and terminal workflows.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone.

Config.Name: Root SSH Password
Config.Description: Root SSH password inside the container. Set a strong password before enabling SSH access from untrusted networks.

Config.Name: OpenCode Username
Config.Description: OpenCode server Basic Auth username.

Config.Name: OpenCode Password
Config.Description: OpenCode server Basic Auth password. Set a strong password.

Config.Name: Enhancement Mode
Config.Description: Enables OpenCode Plus runtime behavior including SSH, state restore, compatibility paths, gateway support, and worktree enforcement. Set false for plain OpenCode server mode.

Config.Name: Gateway Enabled
Config.Description: Starts the OpenCode Plus gateway on port 4097. Cloudflare Access checks require CF_ACCESS_AUD and ALLOWED_EMAILS unless CF_ACCESS_SKIP_AUD is true.

Config.Name: OpenCode Plus UI Enabled
Config.Description: Injects the OpenCode Plus drawer and status UI through the gateway.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Auth Default
Config.Description: Initial gateway auth mode when no saved auth state exists. False lets first-run Unraid installs use OpenCode's own login through the gateway; set true when publishing behind Cloudflare Access from the start.

Config.Name: Gateway Listen Address
Config.Description: Address used by the gateway process inside the container.

Config.Name: Allowed Emails
Config.Description: Comma-separated email allowlist for Cloudflare Access authenticated users. Keep this aligned with your Cloudflare Access policy.

Config.Name: Cloudflare Access Audience
Config.Description: Cloudflare Access audience tag for the protected application. Required unless Skip Cloudflare Audience Check is true.

Config.Name: Skip Cloudflare Audience Check
Config.Description: Set false and provide CF_ACCESS_AUD for stricter Cloudflare Access JWT validation. Default true makes first-run local setup easier while still requiring allowed emails when the gateway is enabled.

Config.Name: OpenCode Workspace Dir
Config.Description: Internal workspace path where opencode serve starts.

Config.Name: OpenCode Repos Dir
Config.Description: Internal repository path for local Git clones.

Config.Name: Deployment ID
Config.Description: Stable identity for sync/backplane records. Use a unique value for each container, such as opencode-plus or opencode-plus-2.

Config.Name: Deployment Name
Config.Description: Human-readable instance name shown in the OpenCode Plus drawer.
